training_reference.scope: SCUT-inspired periodic command ranges and delayed special modes; V5-specific geometry, independent completed-episode statistics and dense references
training_reference.schedule: One long parallel flat phase, then contact recovery, jump, terrain and robust scenes by finite budgets; fixed evaluation never gates continuation
training_reference.initialization_decision: Restart from scratch after V5.6 lost six of seven retained anchors by update 539; keep the original 12486 policy as an independent comparison and deployment artifact
training_reference.rehearsal: Balanced signed base quotas; moving command amplitudes resample every 5-15s without resetting sampled height, episode evidence or latched difficulty
training_reference.height_shape: Performance-driven broad-to-tight height kernels and weights, latched at reset; raw tracking metrics and evaluation thresholds stay fixed
training_reference.special_modes: Spin translation waits for reference update 2000, episode age 5s and a supported stable posture; inactive slots rehearse standing and cannot promote special-mode difficulty
training_reference.stage_transfer: Latest trained actor and shared learned command frontiers; fresh critic and optimizer, fixed 3e-5 and 50 critic warmup updates after flat scratch learning
training_reference.regression: Record fixed evaluations and preserve candidates for human selection; do not stop or delay scene progression because a case or anchor failed
training_reference.recovery: Identical-contract optimizer resume; changed-scene transfer inherits shared frontiers while resetting performance windows
training_reference.source_mechanisms: CommandVelocityProgression and RewardWeightProgression inspire enabled scheduling; ordinary SCUT Flat does not enable all five progression classes; nominal PD, friction and external-assist physics are not simultaneously changed
training_reference.causality: A redesigned scratch curriculum, not a claim that any one change alone fixes prior regression
